title: Paperclip–OpenClaw Operation Registry
description: Registry of all Paperclip Layer 4B operations exposed to OpenClaw agents via the contract facade. Each operation declares its risk classification, mutation flag, idempotency requirements, HTTP verb/path, and optional approval class.

paperclip.ready_work.description: Fetch all work items currently available for the agent to work on.

paperclip.work_item_detail.description: Fetch full detail for a specific work item.

paperclip.raise_blocker.description: Raise a blocker on a work item (indicates it cannot proceed).

paperclip.complete_work_item.description: Mark a work item as complete.

free.description: Operations that need no approval and are always allowed

approval.description: Operations that require explicit operator approval before execution

forbidden.description: Operations not in the registry — blocked unconditionally
